bounded_cusp_links.proof: Every active component has a positive kernel vector. Their quotient normals span Euclidean dimension21. A recession vector pairs nonpositively with every normal, so the positive relations force all pairings zero; spanning then forces that vector to vanish. The ideal endpoint is unchanged and every nonactive wall remains strict.
